items.title: Sebi flags risks of relying on GMP as an IPO price guide
items.description: Securities and Exchange Board of India has advised market participants to stop publishing grey market premium figures. These figures may mislead investors regarding potential listing prices of upcoming IPOs. The regulator emphasized that such transactions lack regulatory oversight and settlement guarantees. Furthermore, the grey market does not adhere to any formal price discovery process. The advisory aims to promote transparency and accountability within the securities market.

Other teams like Bangladesh, England, West Indies, Sri Lanka and Pakistan are unlikely to qualify.

items.title: Sebi warns of fake WhatsApp, Telegram trading groups
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has issued a critical alert about ongoing scams targeting investors. Fraudsters are utilizing WhatsApp and Telegram to deceive individuals by impersonating official intermediaries while pushing unregulated trading platforms. Investors must remain cautious of invitations to unofficial private groups, as SEBI warns against falling for scams promising improbable returns from global stock markets.

items.author: PRANJAL PANDEY
items.description: Washington is investigating Iran's potential involvement in numerous cyberattacks against energy tankers carrying hazardous materials. This probe includes incidents where vessels received bomb threats alleging possible explosions. The investigation comes amid concerns that the conflict may expand beyond the Middle East into cyber operations. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps reported three tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.description: In Hinjewadi, Pune, a software engineer was arrested after allegedly killing his girlfriend during an argument. The couple had been in a relationship for three-and-a-half years and often fought over trivial issues. Following a dinner outing, a violent argument escalated, leading to the woman's death. Her cousin reported her unresponsiveness to the police, prompting their intervention. The police discovered her unconscious, and she was pronounced dead shortly after.

items.title: Shepherds from Rajasthan trek 2,000km to Maharashtra for grass, return without luck
items.author: DHANANJAY SABLE
items.description: A herd of 12,000 sheep and 25 camels has faced severe drought conditions in Maharashtra's Vidarbha region. Herders from Rajasthan, generally welcomed, are transporting their livestock back due to extreme fodder shortages. Local farmers typically benefit from the herds due to manure and natural fertilization provided by the animals. This year, local grazing restrictions and water shortages forced an unexpected return for the herders.

items.title: Jury awards nearly $8m after doctors allegedly miss lung cancer on breast MRI
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: An Oregon jury awarded nearly $8 million to the estate of Wendi K. Lui and her husband after finding a radiology group and its hospital partner liable for missing a lung mass on her 2019 breast MRI. The cancer was detected during a scan in 2020, by which time it had spread to her lymph nodes. Lui died of metastatic lung cancer in 2023, aged 51. Her husband rejected settlement offers and pursued a trial to bring attention to the case.

items.author: PRABIN KALITA
items.description: Recent satellite images reveal notable advancement on China's 60 GW Medog hydropower project, raising concerns for downstream India. items.author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
items.description: Donald Trump took aim at Gavin Newsom's choice to commute the death sentences for 548 inmates, labeling it a disrespectful act toward victims' families. items.title: Nvidia shares jump over 30%, log biggest single-day gain since 2003 as CEO Huang returns
items.author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
items.description: Nvidia's shares increased significantly after Jensen Huang returned as CEO, leading to a rise in AI stocks. The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite saw their largest single-day gains since April 2025. Many other technology and semiconductor companies, including Amazon and Oracle, also experienced stock price increases. This stock market rally followed a previous week of losses and investor concerns surrounding AI investments.
